d.ko: Botan, an apprentice kunoichi, is summoned by the village chief. Her master had been captured. So she is tasked with the mission to rescue her. However, Botan still lacks experience. Will she really be able to save her master?
d.en: Botan, an apprentice kunoichi, is summoned by the village chief. Her master had been captured. So she is tasked with the mission to rescue her. However, Botan still lacks experience. Will she really be able to save her master?
d.zh: 女忍者学徒牡丹受到村长的召见，惊闻她的师父不幸被抓，牡丹由此担负了营救师父的重任。然而牡丹还只是个学徒，缺少经验。她能否成功营救师父呢？
